Metadata.Goal: Provide a usable Domain Operation workbench in web-ide for catalog browsing, exact request preview/editing, execution, and observation.
Metadata.Description: Add `/domain-workbench` over the verified Domain Operation HTTP API and reference bundles, preserving exact request-body authority and existing Kon IDE behavior.

TaskSpace.name: add-domain-workbench-ui
TaskSpace.Description: Implement and verify the domain operation workbench UI over the existing server API.

TaskGroup.name: Workbench contract and RED browser tests
TaskGroup.Description: Pin the user-visible contract before implementation.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: RED tests fail only because the workbench route/UI is missing

Task.name: Write catalog and exact-preview RED E2E tests
Task.Description: Add Playwright tests for `/domain-workbench` catalog load, bundle selector, read-only model source, operation filters, preset request preview, and existing `/` Kon route preservation. Do not implement the page.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: RED tests require both reference bundle ids and at least one operation from each owner family
RED tests assert preset preview contains a complete ExecuteOperationRequest with apiVersion/context/operation/invocation/execution
Existing Kon IDE route remains covered

Task.name: Write execution observation RED E2E tests
Task.Description: Add Playwright tests for exact POST execution, network request body parity, successful write observations, partial batch item mapping, validation/catalog diagnostics, unexpected console errors, and desktop/mobile layout. Do not implement response views.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: RED tests prove the request editor body is the submitted network request body
RED tests require Outcome, Changes, Before/After, Operation Tree, Plan/SQL, and Diagnostics views including unavailable facts
RED tests include mobile viewport assertions with no primary control overlap

TaskGroup.name: Catalog browser and exact request preview
TaskGroup.Description: Build the workbench shell, catalog loading, filters, and exact request editor.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: no second hidden request model is introduced

Task.name: Implement route, catalog client, and bundle panels
Task.Description: Add `/domain-workbench`, `depa-data-domain-operation-contracts` frontend dependency, encode-safe route builders, API client helpers, bundle selector, read-only model source tabs, semantic resource grouping, and operation filter controls using public routes and DTOs.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: The page loads both production reference contexts from the server
Parameterized catalog routes are built with encoded context ids, not fetched as raw `:contextId` templates
Model source content is visible and read-only with no compile/upload controls
Operation filters use owner/behavior/subject/invocation/effect without mutating request JSON

Task.name: Implement preset selector and exact JSON editor
Task.Description: Select presets into a formatted complete request JSON editor, parse local JSON errors, preserve edited body authority, and keep selected catalog facts visible for comparison.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Preset preview includes complete request body and can be copied/edited as JSON
Local invalid JSON blocks execute with a visible editor diagnostic
Changing presets replaces the editor body only from the selected preset request

TaskGroup.name: Execution and observation views
TaskGroup.Description: Post exact requests and render response envelope projections.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: domain failures and partial responses are rendered truthfully

Task.name: Implement execute command and response state
Task.Description: POST the parsed editor JSON unchanged to execute, track loading/domain status, and render HTTP/domain errors without treating HTTP 200 as success-only.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Valid edited JSON is sent unchanged to the execute endpoint
success, partial, and failure response statuses are visually distinct
Catalog mismatch diagnostics remain visible with the edited request body

Task.name: Implement observation tabs
Task.Description: Render Outcome, Changes, Before/After, Operation Tree, Plan/SQL, and Diagnostics tabs, including mutation summaries, batch item mapping, probes, diff, child refs, stages, public plan, and SQL unavailable diagnostics.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: All response outcome variants render as readable structured data
Batch item keys and partial failure mapping are inspectable
Plan/SQL view does not fabricate SQL when runtime reports SQL_TRACE_UNAVAILABLE

TaskGroup.name: Responsive quality and final verification
TaskGroup.Description: Prove the workbench is usable, responsive, and does not regress existing surfaces.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: focused/full E2E, build, and strict Codument checks pass

Task.name: Polish responsive layout and accessibility hooks
Task.Description: Ensure desktop/mobile layouts fit, controls are labelled for E2E/accessibility, tabs remain stable, and text does not overlap.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Desktop and mobile viewport tests pass without incoherent overlap
Primary controls have stable accessible names or test ids
Existing Kon IDE E2E tests remain green

Task.name: Run final verification and archive-ready evidence
Task.Description: Run web-ide E2E, web-server reference tests, package builds, root build, XML/strict Codument validation, diff check, and record findings for archive.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Focused and full workbench/Kon E2E suites pass
web-ide/web-shared/web-server/domain packages and root build pass
behavior delta, track XML, strict Codument validation, and git diff checks pass

Task.name: Correct coding attractor gaps
Task.Description: Add contract-owned complete response parsing, race-safe latest-execution ownership, durable web-ide import guards, and real-browser proof of orthogonal filters plus selection-versus-batch semantics.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Only the newest execution may commit loading, response, or error state across preset/context changes and overlapping delayed requests
A public contract parser rejects malformed or version-skewed complete response envelopes before UI projection
Durable unit/import/browser tests prove all owner families, each independent filter, and rendered selection versus keyed batch semantics

Task.name: Re-run final verification after attractor correction
Task.Description: Repeat focused/full tests, package/root builds, integrity guards, strict Codument, screenshots, and diff checks after T3.3.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Corrected contract, race, import, browser, legacy, and server suites pass
Focused and root builds plus capsule manifests remain green
Strict Codument, XML, screenshots, and diff checks remain archive-ready
